title: KMT01 9-round AES / aes-9r-provisional-malhp-kmt2001-property

display.name: Provisional maximum average linear hull probability

target.description: Nine approximated SPN core rounds (T=9), not a completed nine-round master-key attack. Algorithm 2 would prepend a key-guess round (R=T+1). AES S-box/linear layer with independent uniform 128-bit subkeys.

setting.key_relation: Probability is averaged over independent uniformly sampled round keys, not the standard master-key schedule.
setting.plaintext_model: Linear input/output mask ensemble and known-plaintext data threshold under the source Matsui attack model; no actual attack execution budget.
assumptions: Independent uniform subkeys from Section 2; stochastic equivalence from Section 4.3 is required for translating averaged LP to typical-key attack data.
The inspected computation is unfinished. No unvisited pattern is certified by numerical stabilization between 11% and 43%.

limitations: The2001endpoint remains provisional for its exact version; the later completed results are separately source-bound.
Independent-round-key averaging and conditional Matsui/stochastic-equivalence conversion remain explicit; no standard-master-key attack guarantee.

property.statement: At 43% computation the authors report a provisional MALHP upper-bound estimate UB=2^-92 for T=9 approximated rounds; completion and global certification are not established in this inspected edition. Under the source Matsui/stochastic-equivalence assumptions N_L=c/ELP_T(a,b) and the conditional conversion N_L>=c/UB gives 2^97 for c=32, with source nominal 96.7% success.
property.quantifier: Maximum over nonzero input/output masks of E_k[LP(a,b;k)], where LP=(2*Pr[a dot X = b dot E_k(X)]-1)^2 and k consists of independent uniformly sampled round keys. Not a bound for each fixed AES master key.
property.scope: Provisional output of Figures 2–3 algorithm after 43% of computation for 2<=T<=10; only the explicitly reported T=9 numerical endpoint is extracted. T=11..15 curve is labeled extrapolation.
